p: shalt say: He shows how the Church will praise God, when they are delivered from their captivity.
salvation: Our salvation stands only in God, who gives us an assured confidence, constancy and opportunity to praise him for the same.
draw water out of the wells: The graces of God will be so abundant that you may receive them in as great plenty as waters out of a fountain that is full.
thou inhabitant of Zion: You who are of the Church.
